name: Timeline
description: Events in order, newest or oldest first, each with an icon or dot marker, a head, a time and optional body text or a card. Compose it from TimelineItem children, or pass the same events as items. For steps still to come, use Steps.

livewire.name: timeline
capabilities: Children: timeline-item; items renders the same children, before them
A timeline-item's default slot is its head; its card slot holds rich card content
A 2.x timeline-item's subtitle still works, as time; first, last and pending are ignored

react.name: Timeline
capabilities: Children: TimelineItem, after items; children of an item are its head

vue.name: Timeline
capabilities: Children: TimelineItem, after items; an item's default slot is its head

props.name: items
props.description: The events as data, rendering the same children as composition: { title, time, datetime, icon, color, description, card }. title is the head; time the visible time, with datetime as its machine-readable value; icon a registry name; color tints the marker; description the muted body; card a sunken box, such as a comment.

props.name: variant
props.description: Icon markers in a soft circle, or small dots for a compact status history. Dots leave the icons out. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's accessible name, such as "Activity".

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, its items' included, such as { marker: '…', time: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The ordered list of events. It is the spec's list part.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One event. The line to the next marker is drawn from the inline start, so it mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: marker
parts.description: The icon in a soft circle, or a dot, with data-color. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: head
parts.description: What happened, then the time at the end.

parts.name: time
parts.description: When it happened, with datetime when given.

parts.name: card
parts.description: A sunken box under the head, such as a comment.

requirements: An ordered list, so the count and position are announced.
Times use time elements, with datetime for the machine-readable value.
Markers are decorative and hidden: what happened is in the head, never only in an icon or color.

items.title: Olivia Rhye commented
items.card: Can we move the viewing to Thursday at 11:00?
